name: LG UltraGear 34G600A-B
notes: Mapped on one unit in October 2026. This LG mostly ignores the standard input command (0x60), so inputs use LG's own (0xF4 from address 0x50). It does not report which input it is showing: no readable code, read from either address, changes with the input.FPS and Gamer 1 were confirmed on screen; the other picture-mode codes follow from the menu order. Black Stabilizer reads back as the menu value but is written as the step number 0-20, and Reader and HDR Effect lock it. The DisplayPort input code has not been tested.
